admin.title: مدیریت

admin.recovery_hint: این کد یک‌بارمصرف را کپی کنید و به کاربر بدهید. پس از ۱۰ دقیقه منقضی می‌شود و فقط اینجا نمایش داده می‌شود.

admin.confirm_reset: گذرواژهٔ {name} بازنشانی شود؟ گذرواژهٔ فعلی و همهٔ نشست‌های او از کار خواهند افتاد.
admin.confirm_delete: {name} حذف شود؟ فایل‌های شخصی و سطل زباله حذف خواهند شد. فایل‌های اشتراکی به حساب شما منتقل و در سهمیهٔ شما محاسبه می‌شوند.
admin.confirm_signing: راز امضا تغییر کند؟ همهٔ دستگاه‌ها، از جمله این مرورگر، از حساب خارج می‌شوند.
admin.confirm_encryption: کلید رمزنگاری تغییر کند؟ دسترسی به فایل‌ها تا پایان رمزنگاری مجدد همهٔ فایل‌ها معلق می‌شود. پس از آغاز، لغو عملیات ممکن نیست.

registration_mode.label: Registration
registration_mode.help: Choose whether new accounts are created immediately, approved by an administrator, or closed.

default_quota_bytes.label: Default storage limit
default_quota_bytes.help: Applies to users without an individual storage limit. Zero means unlimited.

host.label: Server address
host.help: Network address the server listens on.

port.label: Server port
port.help: Network port used to open the web client and API.

storage_root.label: File storage folder
storage_root.help: Folder where user files are stored. Changing it requires moving existing files.

db_path.label: Database file
db_path.help: File containing accounts, file records and settings. Changing it requires moving existing data.

temp_upload_dir.label: Temporary upload folder
temp_upload_dir.help: Used while files are being uploaded.

public_dir.label: Web client folder
public_dir.help: Folder containing the compiled web interface.

upload_limit_bytes.label: Maximum upload size
upload_limit_bytes.help: Largest size allowed for a single uploaded file. Zero means no limit.

rate_limit_per_minute.label: Sign-in attempt limit
rate_limit_per_minute.help: Maximum authentication attempts from one address per minute.

access_token_ttl_seconds.label: Session duration
access_token_ttl_seconds.help: How long a signed-in session token remains valid.

refresh_token_ttl_seconds.label: Remembered sign-in duration
refresh_token_ttl_seconds.help: How long a device can renew its session without entering a password.

log_dir.label: Log folder
log_dir.help: Folder where server diagnostic logs are stored.

log_level.label: Log detail level
log_level.help: Choose how much technical information is written to logs.

access_log_enabled.label: Record web requests
access_log_enabled.help: Writes every web request to the access log.

video_thumbs_enabled.label: Generate video previews
video_thumbs_enabled.help: Creates preview images for uploaded videos.

ffmpeg_binary.label: Video processing command
ffmpeg_binary.help: Path or command used to create video previews.

log_retention_days.label: Keep logs for
log_retention_days.help: Number of days diagnostic logs are retained.

hash_files.label: Encrypt stored files
hash_files.help: Keeps files encrypted on disk. Changing this requires a migration.

trash_retention_days.label: Keep deleted files for
trash_retention_days.help: Number of days before files in the trash are permanently removed.
